result.stateSummary: This source is a slice (§379–§493, 2026-08-22 to 2026-08-23) of a chair-kept program ledger — a chronological run of collection, ruling and landing rows for a 45-landing cascade across the map/port, website, producer, undercity, housekeeping and research trains. It records deferral in a strikingly disciplined way: rulings are stamped in place ('RULED', 'RATIFIED', 'CHARTERED', 'SIGNED'), deferrals are named and dated ('QUEUED (deferred, not dropped)', 'DEFERRED-DOCUMENTED', 'docketed to the owner', 'ARCHITECTED-NOT-BUILT'), and owner items accumulate on an explicit OWNER DOCKET with a chair recommendation attached to each. Two owner grants (§464, and the seat/model directives §447/§481/§484) moved most judgment to the chair, leaving a narrow set of items owner-gated by nature: the db push (195–199, with 198 destructive), the Stripe acts, the /code-review ultra keystroke, the tuning signature, legal sign-off, and the cull. Roughly fifty items remain open here: five chartered-but-unbuilt trains (catalog-hygiene, the W-C/W-D website cars, the content train, the DW program, the endgame), about a dozen instrument and housekeeping debts (HK-4, HK-5, HK-6, the declared-movement class, the pulse-time-writer exemption, the comparator divergence row, the prngSeedEntropy tolerance, the worker-cap experiment), and a research layer whose dossiers were accepted only on the condition of a P1c re-verification that has not run. A further standing debt is the OPUS REGISTER: every row from §484 onward is stamped '[OPUS-RUN · FABLE-VALIDATION OWED]', so the validation backlog is still growing at the source's last section.

result.stateSummary: THE OWNER DECISION QUEUE is the estate's single consolidated surface for owner decisions, opened 2026-07-26 by owner order and grown by append into 125 numbered sections spanning 2026-07-26 to 2026-08-15. Resolutions are recorded in place as "✅ RULED <date>: …" and never deleted, so a section without such a line — or one whose ruling only schedules the act ("waits on", "parked", "docketed", "owed", "stays open") — is still open. Its character changes across the file: §§0–9 are a compact decision register (T/D/G/P/M/EP rows), while §§10–125 become a running chair ledger of train rulings in which most "rulings" are dispositions that mint new deferrals — micro-acts, dockets, re-charters and compile obligations — faster than they discharge them. Four superseding owner grants (§17, §22, §24, §37) release nearly every permission-class blocker, but four carve-outs survive by nature and still gate the tail: external legal/counsel, the V5 aesthetic cull, THE TUNING SIGNATURE, and each push/deploy; §53.1's P1 records that even the grants' reach over the signature and pushes is itself an unanswered owner question. Of the ~78 items enumerated here, roughly a dozen are strictly owner acts (the launch tail T1–T15, the §13 worktree, the §67.6 cull, §66.4 import-vs-restore, the M44 dial list, the two tm value flags), about twenty are chartered-but-unbuilt programs (the whole LG logistics family, tm, AO/H26, gen-2, the ~96 remaining family waves, the §109 total review), and the rest are docketed engineering debts and micro-acts queued behind an executor order that the record ends mid-flight. Several rows are genuinely ambiguous — T1 is marked EXECUTED at §0 yet re-asserted as blocking at §71.5/§109.4, and P6 is owner-parked at §56/§71.2 yet decided under delegation at §114 — and are flagged for the synthesizer rather than dropped.

This source is a slice (part 2 of 11) of docs/OWNER_DECISION_QUEUE.md — the estate's running chair ledger, numbered §125 through §270 and dated 2026-08-15 to 2026-08-17. It is not a to-do list: it is a chronological record of owner directives, chair rulings (each marked "vetoable"), lane collections and their receipts, so a ruling appears IN PLACE as a "RULED / RATIFIED / SIGNED / ACCEPTED" sentence inside the section that records it, and a deferral appears as "queued", "owed", "parked", "carried, named", "deferred with cause", "OWNER-GATED", "OWNER-VALUE", or "raised, not settled". The file's overwhelming subject is the map-fabric (mf) program, which ran from a charter (§150) through nine build waves, three prior-art studies, a 313-plate reference corpus and a 24-stage generation specification with a 42-row gap ledger and a nine-wave plan (W0–W8) of which only W0 and W1 had been dispatched when the slice ends mid-sentence at §270. Alongside it run four other undischarged threads: the engine family-train queue (cn/pg/WF/WC/LG/WY/POP and the §27 tail), the soak program (rolling soaks RS-1..RS-3, the diagnostic soak still unfired), the launch/legal cluster (§133/§133a), and a standing 18-item owner decision batch plus a nineteenth item that §264.4 re-confirms as still the owner's. Roughly a quarter of the rows below are owner-gated by the record's own words; most of the rest are chair-chartered work with a named slot (wave nine, W2–W8, "next worktree slot") but no completion recorded anywhere in this slice — and because the slice is truncated at §270, a handful of rows may have been discharged in later parts and are marked unclear where this source itself hints at it.

result.stateSummary: This source is a contiguous slice (§762.1 through §874.3, dated 2026-08-30 to 2026-09-01) of the SettlementForge OWNER DECISION QUEUE — a chair-written, append-only ledger where each numbered § records an owner directive, a chair ruling made under a standing delegation grant, or a train/lane collection and landing. Deferral is recorded in place and in the ledger's own vocabulary: items are "chartered", "docketed", "deferred priced", "priced-not-landed", "owed", "carried", "to the OWNER batch", "flagged to the owner", "vetoable", or "on the morning desk"; a ruling is marked in place (e.g. "RULED", "RATIFIED", "DISCHARGED", "CAS EXECUTED") and a later § routinely reports an item landed, so many rows opened early in the slice are visibly closed later in it. The slice's overall state is a programme running at full saturation toward launch: roughly a dozen trains land to the branch (STRIP-FINISH, HERALD, RESIDUE, W-COIN, EFF-1, T5 Genesis, T10, T2, T7, T6, T9, T11, SEAT-A, T12, DENSITY, the smalls, the character substrate), while at the end of the slice at least a dozen more are built-and-holding but never CASed, and the entire character/faith/ops program ships dark with no flag, no preset and no production caller. The long tail divides into four bands: four owner-gated launch thresholds the chair is ordered never to cross (the visual walkthrough, the iterated ultra loop, the tuning signature, the terminal soak) plus the by-nature carve-outs (db push/deploy, legal sign-off); large chartered-but-unbuilt waves (TE-TRANS-1/T13, TE-GOLDEN-1, TE-CONTENT-2, the sea_battle pool, TE-NPCGEN-1's decomposition, TE-GROWTH-MIG, VAR-1b/2, SEAT-6/7/8, W-OPS O6/O7); a long list of owner-pen rows (the registers pack's taste rows, Register VII values, the seal grace window, WEB-9a, map-chains, the legal/trademark surfaces, persistence-shape questions); and a dense instrument/debt docket. result.stateSummary: This source is the last slice (part 11 of 11) of docs/OWNER_DECISION_QUEUE.md — the estate's single owner-facing ledger — covering §912 through §919 (2026-09-07 to 2026-09-09), the stretch in which the prose reconciliation was ratified, the whole rewrite was commissioned, and six consists landed (L-MAT §913, the instruments §914, the measure train §915, the seam train §916, the light train §917, the taste and sitting §918, the rewrite's first car §919). Its recording convention is dense but consistent: an owner directive is quoted verbatim and stamped "✅ RULED <date>" or "✅ CHAIR RULING <date> (vetoable)"; each landing section then carries fixed sub-headings — "Refusals kept as results", "Deferred, documented, not bugs to re-find", "Rulings (vetoable)", "OWNER ROWS" and "Next:" — so deferral is explicit and auditable rather than implied. Almost everything in this slice is process and instrumentation: five of the six consists moved ZERO reader-facing bytes, and the one that lit a dial (§917) added two keys at birth and wrote no migration. The long tail it leaves is therefore three-layered: a small set of hard owner decisions (the three numbers Q4/Q5/Q15, the schema acts (a)–(k), the `_gallery_dm_full_json` SQL twin, the persisted-receipt marker, the wave's staffing and funding, the seven lost raw exemplar registers, and the standing reservation of the push and the walk); a very large body of chartered-but-unbuilt corpus work (the rewrite wave from 8b onward at roughly ten thousand variants, the authoring wave, the surface-text program, 591 source-unresolved census rows, 448 variants in unmounted blocks, 114 unreachable variants, 128 bare future indicatives); and a long ledger of instrument debts and refusals kept as results. Of the ~75 rows extracted, about half are explicitly deferred with a named future home (8b, the authoring wave, the CAPACITY train, the parity train, a sitting), roughly fifteen are owner-gated with no ruling recorded, and six are marked unclear because a later section in this same source appears to have discharged them (the DM panel's gazetteer source, DS-DEF-2's wiring, the co-occurrence floor, `granary`, the sibling distance measure, the passage-shape ruling) — those need reconciliation against the other parts.

result.stateSummary: This source is part 6 of the ledger inside docs/OWNER_DECISION_QUEUE.md, covering §692 through §748 — the town-map spine/dress/port programme collected wave by wave (§692–§723), then the descope sitting and everything after it (§724–§748). Rulings are recorded in place in the section that makes them, as "RULED", "CHARTERED", "DOCKET ROW STRUCK", "→ OWNER DOCKET" or an explicit owner quote with its verbatim intent; deferrals are almost always named with their rationale ("deferred with rationale", "reported and not cured", "blocked, not run — and named as such"), which makes the open surface unusually legible but very large. The dominant structural fact is the owner's descope (§724, §725, §738, §739, §740): the entire settlement-layer mapmaking programme — including the framing trade, the enclosure operator, the ~3.4× capacity over-statement, the DW dwellings programme, the AD programme, C-19, CT-1b, COVER-REFRESH and the whole undercity train — moves to a post-launch GPL-3.0 module, while the legacy in-product map is stripped entirely. What remains on the launch path is itself substantial and mostly unstarted: STRIP waves 2/4/5/6, the ~21-car FMG WEAVE programme, W-COIN and W-SEAT (both architected and panel-attacked but blocked on owner rows), the MF/WEB/HK/WF-8/catalog residue, one OSR mint, parity, the walk, one regeneration, the terminal soak, the tuning signature and the push. Roughly twenty owner questions stand unanswered at the source's end (Q-W1..Q-W7, Q-W9, Q10, Q11, Q-S2..Q-S8 plus a widened Q4), alongside an older nine-item docket, and a substantial historical debt (130 UNKNOWN-provenance sections, 147 unruled retrovalidation rows, three P0s) that the descope deliberately leaves with launch. The record also carries a long tail of small, well-documented engineering debts — unit-less numeric fields read differently by every consumer, censuses whose predicate is weaker than their name, instruments lagging their own code, and the growth ledger's untested fold — none of which has a car recorded against it.

result.stateSummary: This source is a contiguous slice of the estate's append-only owner/chair ledger (docs/OWNER_DECISION_QUEUE.md), covering §883.3 through §911.1 from 2026-09-02 to 2026-09-07 — roughly twenty landings, each a numbered entry with its own date stamp and seat line (Seat: Opus 5 — Fable-unvalidated, or Fable 5.1 — validated). Deferral is recorded three distinct ways: as explicit "owner rows opened" blocks routed to the owner and never absorbed, as chair rulings marked vetoable with their ground and their veto shape, and as named deferrals-with-a-home ("recorded as a deferral with a home, not a dropped thread"), plus standing lists — the §892.1 fourteen-item LIVE-FAULT LIST and the §910 D1–D5 receipt ledger. Rulings appear in place, usually as "RULED (Fable 5.1)" or "✅ RULED 2026-09-07", and withdrawals as "⛔ SUPERSEDED at §N"; an item with none of these is still open. The dominant open structure at the end of the span is a sequencing chain the owner controls: the reconciliation (S12) must pass, then the taste sample, then the owner's WALK, then the terminal soak, then tuning LAST — and every push and deploy stays the owner's throughout. About a dozen items are pure owner decisions with no ruling anywhere (the watermark, the founder-name producer, DS-GEN-1, the drift door, the espionage sentences, the dossier-pdf over-declarations), roughly fifteen more are ruled-but-unexecuted or awaiting a condition (SOAK-1, CAP-10, CAP-11, the successor presets, rungs 19 and 20, L-MAT), and a long tail of instrument and process debt (the tuning register scoring a naming act as debt, chair-commit.sh's missing prefix gate, the stale heartbeat template, the ratchet's budget misreport) is carried forward without cure. Four prominent rows that were deferred early in this span are shown DONE later in the same source and are marked "unclear" for the synthesizer to reconcile.
